up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity records where standard_type is 'IC50', standard_relation is '=', pchembl_value is not null, and the target is a single protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1764946 (Chromobox protein homolog 7) from Homo sapiens. For each record, return the assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), taxonomy ID (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID then by assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1764946' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
